prompt: We have four charging cables, so please hand me (long) one.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о выборе одного кабеля из четырёх, поэтому нужна превосходная степень с артиклем the: the longest.

prompt: Our back bedroom is the quietest room ___ the whole flat.
explanation_ru: С местом или замкнутым пространством (the whole flat) после превосходной степени используется предлог in, а не of.

prompt: Is this really one of the nicest ___ in York?
explanation_ru: В конструкции one of the + превосходная степень существительное всегда стоит во множественном числе: parks. Частая ошибка — использовать единственное число.

prompt: Choose the blue tent; it has (much / space) of the four.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются четыре палатки, поэтому с неисчисляемым существительным space используется превосходная форма the most space.

prompt: Callum did not start well, but he ran (fast) in our class.
explanation_ru: Сравнивается скорость бега среди всего класса, поэтому у наречия fast нужна превосходная степень (the) fastest.

prompt: Don't delete that bridge photo; it's my (good) shot of all.
explanation_ru: После притяжательного местоимения my артикль the перед превосходной степенью не ставится: my best shot.

prompt: This street is the busiest road of our whole city.
answer: This street is the busiest road in our whole city.
accepted_answers: This street is the busiest road in our whole city.
explanation_ru: С названиями мест и географических объектов (in our whole city) после превосходной степени употребляется предлог in, а не of.

prompt: Welcome to our new school building. Our library is (second / large) room on this floor. Students come here because it is quiet and has (many / book) in the school. You can borrow three books with your student card.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения места в рейтинге используется конструкция the second-largest, а с исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе — превосходная форма the most books.

prompt: Our weekend in Bath was really fun. The fish soup on Sunday was (tasty) meal I have ever had. My little sister usually leaves food on her plate, but she ate (much) of all of us. We want to go back in summer.
explanation_ru: В связке с Present Perfect и ever употребляется превосходная степень the tastiest, а с глаголом eat для сравнения среди всех — (the) most.

prompt: The small pencil drawing near the door is one of (early / picture) in the whole gallery.
explanation_ru: После one of ставится артикль the, превосходная степень earliest и существительное во множественном числе pictures.

prompt: This portable speaker isn't loud enough for a party, but its battery lasts (long) in this price range.
explanation_ru: Сравнивается время работы батареи среди всех моделей ценовой категории, поэтому с глаголом lasts нужна превосходная степень наречия (the) longest.

prompt: Does the city park really look at its (colourful) in October, when all the trees turn orange?
explanation_ru: В устойчивой конструкции at its + превосходная степень артикль the не нужен, так как уже есть притяжательное местоимение its.

prompt: Our new printer isn't cheap to buy, but it uses (little / ink) of all the models we tested.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным ink при сравнении всех моделей используется превосходная форма the least ink.

prompt: Zofia cut half the slides and kept only her three (useful / point) for the client meeting.
explanation_ru: После притяжательного местоимения her артикль the опускается, а числительное three требует множественного числа points.

prompt: Tariq picked ___ phone in the shop because it still had a strong battery.
explanation_ru: Порядковое числительное сочетается с артиклем the и превосходной степенью: the second-cheapest. Ошибка — ставить сравнительную степень (cheaper) или артикль a.

prompt: This folding step ladder is one of the most useful tool we have ever bought for our flat.
answer: This folding step ladder is one of the most useful tools we have ever bought for our flat.
accepted_answers: This folding step ladder is one of the most useful tools we have ever bought for our flat.
explanation_ru: После one of the most useful существительное обязательно ставится во множественном числе: tools, а не tool.

prompt: The upstairs hall isn't very big, but it has the best sound of all the rooms we tried.
answer: The upstairs hall isn't very big, but it has the best sound of all the rooms we tried.
accepted_answers: The upstairs hall isn't very big, but it has the best sound of all the rooms we tried.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: превосходная степень the best правильно сочетается с конструкцией of all the rooms.

prompt: Three cycle paths to Oxford station take the exact same ten minutes. The canal path is among them, so how should you describe it?
options: The canal path is the shortest route to the station.
The canal path is one of the shortest routes to the station.
The canal path is one of the shortest route to the station.
The canal path is the least short route to the station.
explanation_ru: Раз три маршрута одинаково короткие, нельзя назвать один из них единственно кратчайшим — нужна конструкция one of the shortest routes со множественным числом.

prompt: Everyone says the east side of Bristol is (least / popular) area to rent a flat. However, I moved there last year and I have never regretted it. The local sports centre is kept clean, and the buses run (frequently) of any line in the city. On top of that, our street has (few / complaint) about parking in the whole district.
explanation_ru: Для наименьшей степени качества используется the least popular, для наречия — (the) most frequently, а с исчисляемыми существительными во множественном числе — the fewest complaints.

prompt: Our running club tested six pairs of trail shoes on wet hills. The grey pair gripped the muddy path (well) of all six models. Even though it felt heavy, our tester finished the steep climb (quickly) in those shoes. Nobody has ever complained about sore feet after wearing them, and they cost (little) of the whole group.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются шесть пар кроссовок, поэтому глаголы требуют превосходной степени наречий: (the) best от well, (the) most quickly и (the) least от little.

prompt: "Be careful with that blue teapot, Mei — it is one of (old / thing) in Gran's kitchen. She told me she uses it (least / often) of all her teapots because she is scared of dropping it." "Don't worry, I am wrapping this box (carefully) of all the boxes we have packed today. Pass me the tape and one more towel, please."
explanation_ru: После one of нужно множественное число (the oldest things), а для действия в сравнении со всеми предметами используются превосходные формы наречий (the) least often и (the) most carefully.

prompt: Despite having a smaller railway station than several neighbours, Cardiff ranks as (fifth / busy) commuter hub in the national travel report.
explanation_ru: Порядковое числительное с превосходной степенью оформляется через артикль the, при этом у прилагательного busy конечная y меняется на i: the fifth-busiest.

prompt: Kofi had almost no mountain training before the coastal race, yet he became (young / runner) to finish the full trail in under ten hours.
explanation_ru: Перед инфинитивом цели/результата (to finish) используется превосходная степень с артиклем the: the youngest runner to finish.

prompt: The town council promised to cut traffic in half, but the new parking rule attracted (few / supporter) and quickly became its (unpopular) plan of the year.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе используется the fewest supporters, а после притяжательного местоимения its артикль the перед most unpopular не ставится.

prompt: The coastal train line draws thousands of photographers every summer, but it remains ___ line in Scotland whenever winter storms hit.
explanation_ru: Для наименьшей степени признака среди всех линий нужна превосходная форма the least reliable. Частая ошибка — путать least со сравнительной формой less или опускать the.

prompt: While your second draft is the clearer of the two, the opening paragraph remains its the weakest section by far.
answer: While your second draft is the clearer of the two, the opening paragraph remains its weakest section by far.
accepted_answers: While your second draft is the clearer of the two, the opening paragraph remains its weakest section by far.
explanation_ru: Притяжательное местоимение its уже определяет существительное, поэтому артикль the после него лишний: правильно its weakest section.

prompt: Priya, a hotel receptionist, stayed past her shift to help you find a lost suitcase. You want to thank her warmly in a formal email without comparing her to other staff. Which sentence fits best?
options: You have been the most helpful receptionist I have ever met at any hotel.
You have been most helpful during my stay, and I greatly appreciate your kindness.
You have been more helpful than anyone else on the front desk this week.
You have been one of the most helpful people working at this hotel today.
explanation_ru: В официальном стиле most без артикля the означает «очень / исключительно» и выражает искреннюю благодарность без сравнения с другими сотрудниками.

prompt: Every other player in our city basketball team is shorter than Mateo, even though he only joined last month. → Mateo is …
answer: Mateo is the tallest player in our city basketball team, even though he only joined last month.
accepted_answers: Mateo is the tallest player in our city basketball team, even though he only joined last month.
Mateo is the tallest player on our city basketball team, even though he only joined last month.
Mateo is the tallest in our city basketball team, even though he only joined last month.
Mateo is the tallest on our city basketball team, even though he only joined last month.
explanation_ru: Фраза «все остальные игроки ниже» передаётся через превосходную степень the tallest (player) с указанием группы in/on our city basketball team.

prompt: Six local bakers brought their apple pies to the Norwich autumn fair. The judges agreed that Oksana's pie tasted (fresh) of all the entries they had ever tried. Even though she set up her stall last, she served the queue (politely) and sold out (early) of all the bakers. By noon, only a few crumbs remained on her wooden table.
explanation_ru: После глагола-связки taste ставится прилагательное the freshest (в сочетании с ever), а после глаголов действия serve и sell out — превосходные степени наречий (the) most politely и (the) earliest.

prompt: I finally chose between the four job offers I received this month. The design studio in Chester didn't offer (high / salary), but it gave me (flexible / hour) of all the companies. Their manager also answered my questions (honestly) of all the interviewers, which mattered a lot to me. On top of that, I can get there (easily) of all four offices, because it is only a ten-minute walk from my flat. Let's celebrate with dinner this Friday.
explanation_ru: При выборе одного предложения из четырёх существительные требуют превосходных форм прилагательных (the highest salary, the most flexible hours), а глаголы answer и get — наречий (the) most honestly и (the) most easily.
